summary: Implementation plan for unifying Nav Grocery Store and NavKart Supermall across Android (Jetpack Compose) and Web into a single #0F3D28 Forest Green, #F8F7F2 Warm Cream, and #E6A817 Gold storefront with 808 locked SKUs, Google Gmail Sign-In at Account & Checkout, Saved Delivery Addresses CRUD, server-validated checkout & receipt generation, isolated SHA-256 Admin control, and Firebase security rules.
